rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for people communicating and doing things together.

example.english: I interact really well with my students.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 hok6 saang1 wu6 dung6 dak1 hou2 hou2

rows.note: Use this when the interaction emphasizes spending time together or getting along with people.

example.english: I interact pretty well with my new colleagues.
example.traditional: 我同新同事相處得幾好。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 san1 tung4 si6 soeng1 cyu5 dak1 gei2 hou2

rows.note: Use this for conversational interaction, especially chatting casually with people.

example.english: After work, I like to interact by chatting with people.
example.traditional: 放工後我鍾意同人傾偈。
example.jyutping: fong3 gung1 hau6 ngo5 zung1 ji3 tung4 jan4 king1 gai2

rows.note: Use this when two substances, forces, or things affect one another.

example.english: Water temperature and air pressure interact with each other.
example.traditional: 水溫同氣壓會互相影響。
example.jyutping: seoi2 wan1 tung4 hei3 aat3 wui5 wu6 soeng1 jing2 hoeng2
